sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: بغدير بعيد، بين جبلين، كان في تلات سمكات.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: in a far pond, between two mountains, there were three fish.

sentences.ar: عاشوا سوا سنين، وكانوا أصحاب.
sentences.en: They had lived together for years, and were friends.

sentences.ar: بس كانوا مختلفين بالعقل.
sentences.en: But they differed in mind.

sentences.ar: الأولى عاقلة، بتفكر بالإشي قبل ما يصير.
sentences.en: The first was wise; she thought about a thing before it happened.

sentences.ar: التانية نص نص، بتفكر لما يصير.
sentences.en: The second was middling; she thought when it happened.

sentences.ar: والتالتة غافلة، ما بتفكر أبداً.
sentences.en: And the third was heedless; she never thought at all.

sentences.ar: بيوم، مر صيادين جنب الغدير.
sentences.en: One day, fishermen passed by the pond.

sentences.ar: شافوا المي صافية والسمك كبير، وفرحوا.
sentences.en: They saw the clear water and the big fish, and were glad.

sentences.ar: قال واحد للتاني: اليوم ما معنا شبك.
sentences.en: One said to the other: today we have no nets.

sentences.ar: بكرا منرجع لهون ومنصيد كل اللي فيه.
sentences.en: Tomorrow we come back here and catch everything in it.

sentences.ar: والسمكات التلات سمعوا كل كلمة.
sentences.en: And the three fish heard every word.

sentences.ar: السمكة العاقلة ما استنت.
sentences.en: The wise fish did not wait.

sentences.ar: قالت: الخطر جاي، والطريق لسا مفتوح.
sentences.en: She said: the danger is coming, and the road is still open.

sentences.ar: كان في مجرى زغير بيوصل الغدير بالنهر.
sentences.en: There was a small channel joining the pond to the river.

sentences.ar: سبحت فيه بنفس الليلة، وطلعت للنهر، ونجت.
sentences.en: She swam through it that same night, came out into the river, and was saved.

sentences.ar: السمكة النص نص قالت: خلينا نشوف بكرا.
sentences.en: The middling fish said: let us see tomorrow.

sentences.ar: يمكن ما يرجعوا.
sentences.en: Perhaps they will not come back.

sentences.ar: والغافلة قالت: صيادين؟
sentences.en: And the heedless one said: fishermen?

sentences.ar: أنا عايشة هون من سنين وما صار إشي.
sentences.en: I have lived here for years and nothing has happened.

sentences.ar: تاني يوم الصبح رجعوا الصيادين، ومعهم شبك.
sentences.en: The next morning the fishermen returned, and with them nets.

sentences.ar: وأول إشي عملوه، سكروا المجرى بحجر.
sentences.en: And the first thing they did was block the channel with a stone.

sentences.ar: السمكة النص نص شافت الحجر، وفهمت إن الطريق سكر.
sentences.en: The middling fish saw the stone, and understood the road was closed.

sentences.ar: فكرت بسرعة.
sentences.en: She thought fast.

sentences.ar: وقالت: ما بقدر أهرب، بس بقدر أعمل حالي ميتة.
sentences.en: And she said: I cannot flee, but I can play dead.

sentences.ar: قلبت على ظهرها وطفت عالمي، وما تحركت.
sentences.en: She turned on her back, floated on the water, and did not move.

sentences.ar: الصياد مسكها وشمها وقال: هاي ميتة من زمان.
sentences.en: The fisherman grabbed her, smelled her and said: this one has been dead a long time.

sentences.ar: ورماها عالشط، وهي انزحفت للنهر ونجت.
sentences.en: And he threw her onto the bank, and she wriggled to the river and was saved.

sentences.ar: أما الغافلة، فضلت تسبح يمين وشمال.
sentences.en: As for the heedless one, she kept swimming left and right.

sentences.ar: كل ما تيجي الشبكة، تهرب لجهة، وتلاقي شبكة تانية.
sentences.en: Every time the net came, she fled to one side, and found another net.

sentences.ar: وبالآخر انمسكت.
sentences.en: And in the end she was caught.

sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: التفكير قبل الخطر أحسن من التفكير بعده.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: thinking before danger is better than thinking after it.

sentences.ar: والتفكير بعده أحسن من ولا تفكير.
sentences.en: And thinking after it is better than no thinking at all.

sentences.ar: قال الملك: وأنا أي سمكة؟
sentences.en: The king said: and which fish am I?

sentences.ar: ضحك بيدبا وقال: اللي بيسأل هالسؤال، ما بيكون التالتة.
sentences.en: Bidpai laughed and said: whoever asks that question is not the third.
